historical_claims.anchor: When the ball is over, Woland offers Margarita a reward.
Levi Matvei comes to Woland as a messenger from Yeshua. He asks for the Master and Margarita to receive peace.

work.note: Existing bibliography and claim 030000-c01 identify the posthumous, censored Moskva serialization in 1966–1967. This is not the composition period or a claim that the first serialized text was unabridged.

description: Retells The Master and Margarita across Woland’s chaotic visit to Moscow, the Master’s persecution, Margarita’s devotion, and the parallel story of Pontius Pilate.
